remarks: A rare mid-city Stamford condo offering the perfect blend of space, location, and lifestyle. With over 1,800 sq ft of usable space, this home features 1,225 sq ft of living area plus a fully finished 613 sq ft half-basement, ideal for a home gym, office, or extra room. Enjoy a primary bedroom with peaceful golf course views and a walk-in closet. The bright kitchen faces the side yard, and there are two parking spots-1 reserved, 1 guest. Located in a well-maintained and professionally managed community. Enjoy easy access to shopping, dining, parks, hospital, and public transportation - all just minutes away. Whether you're commuting to work or enjoying a weekend out, you'll appreciate the proximity to major highways and train stations. The area is known for its walkability, tree-lined streets, and welcoming atmosphere.
